notes.title: Hotfix v 1.2.0
notes.content:
We’re bringing you an update with improvements and fixes to make your workouts smoother and more enjoyable: 

Offline Mode: Sessions in offline mode now appear correctly.,

DLCs: Fixed an issue that prevented cosmetics from DLCs purchased outside the game from showing up properly.,

Infinite Loading Screen: We’ve addressed a recurring issue that caused infinite loading screens for many users. While we can’t guarantee it’s 100% resolved for everyone, our tests indicate it should no longer occur.,

Several visual bugs have been fixed to improve the overall look of the game.,

UI Adjustments: Fixes to the menu, including the button to open/close dojos.,

Minor visual improvements for a more polished experience.
